name: Discord
description: Discord Bot integration for ActonOS AI agents with rich embeds, multi-account gateway, and agent routing
author: ActonOS

poll_interval_seconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: Time delay in seconds between consecutive message processing cycles

accounts.title: Bot Accounts
accounts.description: Configure one or multiple Discord bot accounts for simultaneous Gateway listening

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Unique identifier for this bot instance used for routing and session isolation

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Friendly label for this bot account

bot_token.title: Discord Bot Token
bot_token.description: Bot Token from Discord Developer Portal (securely stored in Hardware Vault)

default_agent.title: Default Target Agent
default_agent.description: Default ActonOS agent to dispatch incoming messages when no explicit @mention is present

listen_target.title: Listen Channel ID
listen_target.description: Optional Discord Channel ID to restrict HTTP polling (leave empty for Gateway-only / all channels)

enable_typing_indicator.title: Live Typing Indicator
enable_typing_indicator.description: Broadcast '[Bot] is typing...' while the agent generates a reply

enable_ack_reaction.title: Acknowledge with Reaction
enable_ack_reaction.description: React to the user's message to acknowledge receipt

enable_reply_quote.title: Quote / Thread Reply
enable_reply_quote.description: Attach outbound replies as a Discord message reference to the source message

enable_embeds.title: Enable Rich Embeds
enable_embeds.description: Format outbound replies using Discord rich embeds when embed_title metadata is set
